name: Rizuhble's Human Shield Abrams
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Seismic Impact T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Extra Spirit, vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Extra Spirit completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Extra Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.caption: +20 spirit adds about 28 to Shoulder Charge's damage (1.40x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Siphon Life: its duration-scaled parts (duration 4s) get +22%.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. +10 spirit adds about 23.2 to Seismic Impact's damage (2.33x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-22,400 (levels 16-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Siphon Life T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Shoulder Charge, damage) grows from 130 to 196.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Siphon Life: widens its radius.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 6.4k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Siphon Life: takes 18% off its 22s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 41.9 to Seismic Impact's damage (2.33x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Seismic Impact immunity duration (5s), Seismic Impact stun duration (2.4s), Siphon Life duration (6s). Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 3 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 240s; 20% off is 48s per full rotation.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Seismic Impact impact radius (15m), Siphon Life radius (10m). Takes spirit from 15,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 22,400-44,800 (levels 26-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Infernal Resilience T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Shoulder Charge, damage) grows from 196 to 332.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Cast it on yourself as you ult in.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 69.8 to Seismic Impact's damage (2.33x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 24,000 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Arcane Surge.
sections.desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Arcane Surge.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Against gun heroes: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta, Infernus.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Against gun heroes who stand still and shoot you: Wraith, Haze, Bebop.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Two or more gun heroes keep hitting you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Against spirit heroes: Seven, Geist, Pocket, Kelvin.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slowing Hex, Infernus burn, Knockdown before it lands.

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Siphon Life hits many times a second, so the lifesteal heals a lot. Sell Healbane for this.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Sell Arcane Surge for this, or Superior Duration if it's gone.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
